sottotitolo: Fill in and sign from your phone: nobody will ask you again for the data the school already has.

modelli.certificatoBonusNido: Certificate for the INPS nursery allowance

descrizioni.schedaSanitaria: Paediatrician, emergency contacts and what to do if your child feels unwell.
descrizioni.autorizzazioneFarmaci: Needed when a medicine has to be given during school hours: without it, teachers cannot administer anything.
descrizioni.dietaSpeciale: For allergies, intolerances or dietary choices: the kitchen prepares a different meal.
descrizioni.delegaRitiro: Who else, besides you, may come and pick your child up.
descrizioni.permessoOrario: To arrive later or leave earlier, once or for a period.
descrizioni.autorizzazioneUscita: For school trips and activities outside the building.
descrizioni.certificatoIscrizioneFrequenza: States that your child is enrolled and attending: employers and many offices ask for it.
descrizioni.certificatoBonusNido: The certificate INPS asks for the nursery allowance, with the details of the building’s authorisation.

nonFirmabileFirmaDellaScuola: This document is not signed with your own code: the legal representative of the school signs it.
nonFirmabileSecondaFirmaMancante: The pick-up authorisation is signed by both parents or guardians, and collecting the second signature is not available yet: for now, hand the authorisation in at the school office.
nonFirmabileAllegatoNonCaricabile: The pick-up authorisation asks for a scan of the ID of every authorised person, and it cannot be uploaded from the app yet: hand it in at the school office.
campiSottotitolo: Name, date of birth, tax code and class are added by the app.

datiApp.titolo: What the app fills in on its own

delegatiVuoti: No authorised person is on file for this child: you can only name yourself here. Pick-up authorisations are registered at the school office.
delegatiNonLetti: The list of authorised people did not load, so here you can only name yourself. Reload the page in a few minutes: a name typed by hand could not be checked by the school, and the form would be rejected.
allegatoAiuto: The file is uploaded once from the «Medical certificates» tab: here you just link it to the form.
allegatoScegli: Pick a certificate you already uploaded…
allegatoVuoto: No uploaded certificate is on file for this child: upload it from the «Medical certificates» tab and come back here.
allegatoNonLetto: The list of uploaded certificates did not open: please try again in a few minutes.
allegatoNonCaricabile: This attachment cannot be uploaded from the app yet: the form has to be handed in at the school office.
riepilogoSottotitolo: Once signed, the form can no longer be changed: if something is not right, go back now.
otpSottotitolo: We send you a one-time code: entering it signs the form.
otpRinvia: It did not arrive: send it again
otpAttesa: You can ask for another one in {n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
otpNonConsegnato: The code does not appear to have been delivered: if it does not arrive, write to the school office.
otpNonInviato: The code was not sent: please try again in a few minutes.
otpErrato: Invalid code: check the digits and try again.
otpScaduto: The code has expired: ask for another one.
otpGiaUsato: This code has already been used: ask for another one.
otpTroppiTentativi: Too many attempts: wait a few minutes and try again.
firmaDueGenitori: This form is signed by both parents: the other one gets a code of their own.
confermaTesto: It is already on file: the school can see it without you handing in anything.
inAttesaDirezioneTitolo: Signed, waiting for the head office
inAttesaDirezioneTesto: The authorisation is signed, but until the head office accepts it nobody may administer the medicine. Download the PDF and take it to the school office: it is the only copy you keep.
mancatoArchivioTipoDocumentoNonAmmesso: The signature is valid and the PDF is yours, but the school archive does not accept this kind of document yet: download it now and keep it.
mancatoArchivioSchemaNonPronto: The signature is valid and the PDF is yours, but the archive is not ready to receive it yet: download it now and keep it.
mancatoArchivioArchivioNonScritto: The signature is valid and the PDF is yours, but the document did not reach the archive: download it now, keep it and tell the school office.
vuotoFigli: No child appears to be linked to this account: please write to the school office.
vuotoModuli: There is no form to fill in right now.
erroreElenco: The list did not load: please try again in a few minutes.
erroreModulo: The form did not open: please try again in a few minutes.
erroreGenerazione: The form was not generated: please try again in a few minutes.
erroreFirma: The signature did not go through: the form was not sent.
erroreDatiMancanti: Some data the form must carry is missing: please write to the school office.
certificatoProtocollato: Issued with a protocol number and signed by the legal representative.
certificatoNuovoAiuto: The button next to this one always downloads the same certificate, with the same protocol number, for the whole current school year. Next year a new one is issued on its own, because the certificate states the year. “Generate a new one” is only needed if an office wants a more recent date.
certificatoLegaleRappresentanteAssente: The name of the person who signs for the school is missing from the location settings: let the office know, the certificate will be issued as soon as it is there.
certificatoAutorizzazioneNidoMancante: This location has no recorded nursery operating licence details: without them INPS would reject the certificate. Let the office know.
certificatoLivelloNonNido: The INPS Nursery Bonus certificate is only issued for children attending the nursery: for the others you need the enrolment and attendance certificate.
erroreCertificato: The certificate was not generated: try again in a few minutes.
certificatoNonArchiviato: The certificate was issued, but it did not make it into the school archive: keep it now, it is the only copy you have. Do not press “Generate” again: that would issue another one with a new protocol number. Please let the school office know.
avvisoSanitario: What you write here concerns your child’s health: it is read by the school office and by the teachers of their class, and by nobody else.
